result_summary: SPLiT is promoted as a fresh quantitative candidate for adaptive learning under low-dimensional representational drift, but Oja-specific superiority is unresolved. In the reduced held-out control, generic aligned EW-PCA significantly beat tuned Oja at medium/fast drift, while Oja beat a frozen subspace at fast drift. This prioritizes equal-coordinate-budget low-rank baselines on the source task. iTDS sign ambiguity narrows to implementation-path/prose rather than equation-level convention.
